title: Grateful Dead Live at Thelma Theater on 1969-12-10
lineage: (set 1: SBD> MR), (set 2: AUD> MR> R) > D> CD> EAC> SHN

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear matrix recording captures a jam‑laden show highlighted by Black Queen and the epic Cryptical > Other > Cryptical sequence.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its radiant, almost studio‑like clarity despite being a soundboard/audience mix, with only a brief drop‑out on “Charlie.” The performance itself is described as one of the band’s greatest jams, featuring soaring versions of Black Queen, the Cryptical > Other > Cryptical suite, Cosmic Charlie and sweet guest contributions from Stephen Stills on Schoolgirl and Morning Dew.

ai_rating.rationale: Multiple detailed 5‑star reviews praise both the musical performance and the pristine recording; only a minor cut is noted, yielding an overall near‑exceptional rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as crystal‑clear, radiant and pure; a small glitch where “Charlie” cuts out, but overall superb balance of board and audience sources.

standout_songs: Cryptical Envelopment > The Other One > Cryptical Envelopment
show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows as a continuous, high‑energy jam session with each song finding the band at the top of their game; transitions feel natural and the overall pacing is exhilarating.
